_meta.notes: requirement_summary and notes are mapped as text (not aggregatable) since some Indonesian legal-text summaries exceed the default keyword ignore_above; the dashboard table panel buckets on legal_requirement_id/category/status instead. This is a single, non-time-series registry (unlike pdp-evidence-*/pdp-assessment-*/pdp-findings-*): documents are upserted in place by legal_requirement_id as review status changes, not accumulated per month.
